shared_elements: horizontal band/row of repeated geometric or sign-like motifs
schematic relief figures on a vertical surface
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces combine stylized creature imagery with circular/disc-like motifs and rows of repeated sign-like decoration. The biggest difference is that B is organized around a frontal standing human figure beneath stacked mask-like faces, while A is dominated by profile animals and scattered schematic motifs without the same central anthropomorphic scene.
